NOTE
**Still not ready**

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ✅  | Description, "Fixes: #17419" and how it was tested are filled in |
| ✅  | Before/after screenshots, posted in a comment |
| ✅  | Regression test case added in a new push after the feedback |
| ⚠️  | Self-review checklist is there, but it is a custom list, not the PR template's checklist |
| ❌  | Commit discipline: fixes are not squashed into the commits they belong to ("fixed linting error to pass CI", a separate "added test case" commit), commit messages don't follow Zulip's format, and the test commit names #17418 instead of #17419 |
| ℹ️  | CI status is unknown (check runs aren't available) |

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and ask the author to clean up the commits and use the template's self-review checklist.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for adding the test, @adityas27! Two things are still needed: please squash the lint fix and the test into the commit they belong to, with a proper commit message following our [commit discipline guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/commit-discipline.html) (the test commit also says #17418 instead of #17419). Please also replace the self-review checklist with the one from the PR template.
```
